metadata.title: Capacity/use-case balance protocol with scene on every camera
metadata.aggregate_camera_target: sum(desired camera FPS); N*FPS for equal rates
metadata.aggregate_active_scene_target: N/2 samples, JPEGs and vectors per second before extra scopes/triggers

principal_control.activity: busy and actually exercising declared analytics

execution_durations.warmup: measured and excluded; do not reuse one universal fixed compile time
execution_durations.note: Do not run every profile/count for an hour; longer qualification follows cheaper passing gates and the requested execution scope.

scene_freshness_proposed.boundary: independently marked source/PES to complete agent acceptance; source capture/encoding and downstream Management excluded

must_also_pass: every-camera scene cadence and JPEG/vector completeness
no unexplained native errors or CPU model/decode fallback
declared resource/thermal envelope and operational headroom
metrics: actual detections/tracks/eligible ROIs and subject lifetimes
per-model calls and queue wait/depth/oldest age
independent source-to-agent latency and signed UTC error
cgroup RAM and unique-process RSS/PSS/live state/surfaces/FDs/threads
GPU engine busy and scope/frequency/allocations where measurable
NPU supported busy/frequency/allocations and actual model placement
required_result_dimensions: per-camera worst FPS and scene freshness
metadata.delivery_scope: CV package to compatible agent API, not downstream Management storage/search
